title: YORUSHIKA LIVE ‘Plagiarism’ – Limited Collectible Special Screening

title_lang.en: YORUSHIKA LIVE ‘Plagiarism’ – Limited Collectible Special Screening
title_lang.zh_hk: YORUSHIKA LIVE 「盗作」限量珍藏特典場

synopsis:
Yorushika is a band formed by composer n-buna and vocalist suis.
In October 2025, Yorushika held YORUSHIKA LIVE TOUR 2025 “Plagiarism: Reprise” at K-Arena Yokohama, a conceptual live performance combining readings by n-buna with musical performances.
Special theatrical screenings will be held in cinemas across Japan and in selected countries worldwide. Hong Kong and Macau will release on 9 October.


The film will be presented in 5.1-channel surround sound and high-definition video, offering audiences the opportunity to experience the world of Yorushika on the big screen.
Experience Yorushika’s unique world, woven from music and storytelling like a novel or a film, with powerful surround sound on the big screen.
